reports.title: Yellow Fever outbreak in Nigeria
reports.summary:
The Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention released an official update on the ongoing Yellow Fever outbreak in the country. The update provides the current status of the outbreak.

Nigerians remain at risk of contracting Yellow Fever, especially in areas where cases have been reported. Health officials are monitoring the situation to prevent further spread and protect the population.
